subject: cd
question: Remove left recursion: S→S+(E)|(E), E→E*(F)|(F), F→F(S)|id.
title: Rewrite The Loop Away
hook: Three rules, one endless loop. Fix it.
answer: Left recursion A→Aα|β becomes A→βA', A'→αA'|ε.
S→S+(E)|(E) (α = +(E), β = (E)) becomes S→(E)S' and S'→+(E)S'|ε.
E→E*(F)|(F) (α = *(F), β = (F)) becomes E→(F)E' and E'→*(F)E'|ε.
F→F(S)|id (α = (S), β = id) becomes F→idF' and F'→(S)F'|ε.
Same language, no left recursion: the top-down parser no longer loops.
